01910 Hadadrimmown {had-ad-rim-mone'}

源自 01908 與 07417; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Hadadrimmon 1; 1

哈達臨門 = "石榴樹的哈達"
1) 位於米吉多的山谷之處,由於約阿施王之死,
   米吉多是個國喪發生地; 以兩個敘利亞神命名. (#亞12:11|)
record.edic_text:
01910 Hadadrimmown {had-ad-rim-mone'}

from 01908 and 07417;; n pr loc

AV - Hadadrimmon 1; 1

Hadad-rimmon = "Hadad of the pomegranates"
1) a place in the valley of Megiddo where a national lamentation was
   held for the death of King Josiah; named after two Syrian gods
